_comment: Right Path Daily Direction / Next Best Action decision. Adapted from IPF (bobpfromm/ipf-stewardship) src/rules/next-best-action.json, which is the established GoRules ZEN decision layer. This is a first-slice adaptation to the facts Right Path actually records today: the shared Stewardship outreach board. Right Path does not yet record employee capabilities, producer appointments, or exact-time commitments, so the owned/support and exact-time-commitment inputs of the IPF rule are intentionally not present here (they must not be invented). As Right Path gains those records, add the corresponding inputs/rows to converge on the full IPF rule rather than branching in TypeScript. ZEN owns the priority ordering; TypeScript only normalizes facts and renders prose. Date-only callbacks are surfaced as a due-callback PRIORITY, never as an exact-time commitment.

rules._description: A customer we promised to call back today controls the day: a kept commitment outranks ordinary queue work. Date-only callback, surfaced as a priority, not an exact-time reminder.
No callback is due. Ready-to-call work is the next action when it is the top action queue: a reached call moves a customer forward fastest.
Ready-to-email work is the next action when it is the top action queue.
Research-needed is exception work: it is the next action only when it is the top action queue (no ready-to-call or ready-to-email work remains).
Any other action work available: do it.
No action work, but items are waiting on customers or carriers: nothing to push right now, work is in flight.
